read_memory.name: read_memory
read_memory.description: Read a memory value by key from the built-in system tool. If no key provided, list all available keys.

memory_key.description: Key to read. Omit to list all available keys.

memory_value.description: The value stored under the specified key, or a list of keys if no key provided.
